page.title: Access policies
page.description: Allow and Deny rules scoped to an app, database or environment. A Deny always wins; an Allow can grant narrower access than a token's global abilities.

empty.title: No policies yet
empty.description: Start from a template or build one rule by rule. Nothing changes for anyone until a policy is attached.

builder.description: Choose what is allowed or denied, on which resources. The JSON on the right is generated and is what gets stored.
builder.name: Name

effect.label: Effect
effect.allowHint: Grants these abilities on the resources below.
effect.denyHint: Blocks these abilities on the resources below, even for a token that holds them.

actions.label: Abilities
actions.allHint: Matches any current or future ability, root included.

resources.label: Resources
resources.noOptions: Nothing of this kind exists yet.
resources.patternHint: Ends in * to match a prefix, for example app:web-*
resources.projectNote: Expands to the project's {{count}} environments when saved.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: The evaluator has no condition engine yet, so rules apply unconditionally. Scope by environment with the resources above.

json.title: Document
json.advancedHint: Editing here replaces the guided rules. Field errors point at the path.
json.invalid: This is not a valid policy document: {{reason}}

attach.title: Attach on save
attach.description: Optional. Pick who gets this policy right away.

impact.title: What this changes
impact.guardBlocked: Blocked: this would leave no root principal able to manage the platform.

detail.title: Policy details
detail.nobody: Not attached to anyone. It has no effect until attached.

empty.title: No users or tokens match
empty.description: Clear the search or switch the filter.

pickOne.title: Pick a user or token
pickOne.description: See what it can do and which policies shape that.

access.noPolicies: No policies attached. Only its own abilities apply.

attachDialog.description: Review what changes, then confirm. The change is written to the audit log.
attachDialog.noPrincipals: Choose at least one user or token

effective.title: What can {{name}} do?
effective.restricted: This principal only sees environments it was granted.

simulator.title: Can this principal do this?
simulator.description: Runs the same evaluator that guards every request. Nothing is changed.

decidedBy.explicit_deny: An explicit Deny in an attached policy decided this.
decidedBy.base_ability: The principal's own abilities grant it, and no Deny matched.
decidedBy.explicit_allow: An Allow in an attached policy grants it.
decidedBy.no_grant: Nothing grants it: no ability and no Allow statement matches.
decidedBy.hidden: The resource is outside the environments this principal can see, so it answers not found.
decidedBy.inactive_principal: This token is revoked or expired, so every request is refused.

simulator.noneMatched: No statement in any attached policy matched.
simulator.needsInput: Choose a principal and a resource first.

analyzer.title: Policy analyzer
analyzer.description: Static checks over every policy, attachment and token. Each finding says what to change.

clean.title: No findings
clean.description: Nothing in your policies needs attention.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Everyone it is attached to loses its rules. This cannot be undone.
